name: Mamiya Hasaki
source:
[url=https://vndb.org/c3560]Takuji[/url]'s younger sister, Hasaki, is the protagonist of the "Which Dreamed It" chapter. She's a shy and timorous girl, who carries a stuffed rabbit doll around with her everywhere she goes. [spoiler]Hasaki is very attached to her older brother and often visits him at his school, though she doesn't attend the said school herself. She works at the same bar as [url=https://vndb.org/c3561]Tomosane[/url] by helping out and cooking in the kitchen.[/spoiler]

[Edited from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wonderful_Everyday]Wikipedia[/url]]
